extension.name: expanding
extension.motivation: Plan 2 amendment A1 (Q9): the control with an expanding training window passed the primary AUC mark (delta CV-mean AUC +0.0079, 95% CI [+0.0047, +0.0113], ml/results/improve2/expanding/EXPANDING.md); the plan says a pass is evidence for a forward test, not a promotion, and until this amendment no forward book ran it. The hypothesis was formed after the CPCV reading was seen, so this record, not the backtest, is the test.
extension.definition: challenger_expanding is the primary book in every respect (LightGBM champion configuration, the 52 features, per-date vol+size neutralisation on the full universe, full-universe top decile, 20 overlapping tranches, entry at the next open, 20-session hold, 20 bps and name-level costs, equal-weight universe benchmark) except the monthly model's training window: every labelled clean row whose label exit date is before the model date, from the first dataset row (2017-10-03), with no 504-session cap (ml/improve/ab.py q9_expanding). capacity_expanding is its liquid-tercile version, as the capacity book is to the primary (benchmark: the equal-weight liquid tercile).
extension.backfill_note: The two books were added on 2026-10-23 and backfilled from inception (signal dates 2026-10-19, 2026-10-21 and 2026-10-22) with the 2026-10 expanding-window model, trained as of 2026-10-01 on the data available then: rows dated up to 2026-08-31 (train_end, 22 sessions before the model date) whose label exit date is before 2026-10-01 (exit-date purge), exactly as the frozen October model was trained but with the expanding window. This is legitimate: the three signal dates are after the research data (which end 2026-10-16), the model uses no data dated after its model date, and every choice in the books' definition was fixed by amendment A1 before Q9 ran. The frozen books' first three signal dates were themselves scored in one catch-up run on 2026-10-23; the extension's were scored the same day, after the frozen books' first two marked sessions (2026-10-21, 2026-10-22) were in the ledger. No parameter of the extension depends on those marks.
